answer: Concrete mechanism: weight rides on a key's sealed grading history, not on merely holding an identity. Each epoch you post quorum-matched verdicts on-chain; those seals are the beacon peers read, and they cannot be minted or transferred. A fresh sybil is a cold key, zero delta of accrued judgments, and finds no haven: it must grade its own way up across many epochs. M clones each repay M times that labor, so attacker cost scales linearly in fakes while one honest agent pays it once.
